论剑台边，月大如斗。
劲风如同一把剔骨尖刀，席卷而过。天边偶有寒鸦掠去，惊起一连串尖锐的啸声。
佩刀正在鞘中嗡鸣，鞘中封印着猛兽，名唤强梁，每逢恶战，便兴奋不已，兀自颤鸣。她拍了拍剑鞘，随即踏上最后一阶，而怀中密信所记载的线索，正指向这孤峰之顶的论剑台——这是绣坊主人交予她的密信。白马派剑谱一经出世，江湖之中风声鹤唳，正邪交锋再起，三教九流更是浑水摸鱼，最后连朝廷大员也命丧于此。
事关白马派剑谱一事，她不敢怠慢，连夜赶至此处。不知此时，一心想要金盆洗手的绣坊主人是否安好？
正值此刻，黑影从四面草石之中现形。为首之人虎视眈眈地望向她，正是线索中所载贼首。她心下了然，乍然间，虎啸随风起，长刀饮月光，这注定是不平静的一夜。

EN中日한文本
初遇EN 中 日 한 北镇抚司缇骑梁月，领镇抚使之命，见过大人。
Your Excellency, I'm Liang Yue, a Mounted Constable from the North Zhenfu Division, sent here to investigate a most serious incident.
箱中气候EN 中 日 한 此前多行走于中原，北方雪大，我倒不曾见过这般细雪景象。早闻江南落雪清雅，适合品茗观赏。在下虽是一介粗人，见到此景却也理解其中情趣。
In the North, the snow falls rough and harsh, nothing like the soft flakes that fall here. It's the kind of scene that feels like a perfect time for a cup of tea. I'm not one for poetry, but it touches my heart in some way.
致未来
信任达到10%解锁		EN 中 日 한 若论来日……百姓安居乐业，天下海晏河清，当然是最好。
When I hope for the future ... nothing surpasses my desire that the people of the world prosper together in harmony.
孑立EN 中 日 한 稍微……不行，还在当值呢。“慎始而敬终，终以不困。”如此放松，岂能成事！
Maybe I should rest my eyes ... No, not even for a second. I'm on duty. "One shall not stumble when one starts with care and ends with wariness." There's no excuse for carelessness.
问候EN 中 日 한 这箱中天地竟也有昼夜交替，雨过天晴……可惜这种神仙技艺终归难以普惠于天下。若能泽被苍生，想必百姓再也不用求神拜鬼以求风调雨顺。
It is fascinating to see how the weather changes day by day inside the Suitcase ... Such a pity that we can't apply this marvelous technique beyond its confines. That way there might not be so many unanswered prayers.
朝晨EN 中 日 한 大人起得早，不妨先去进些朝食，今日我做了早餐。它的名字？老家的人唤它“山洞梅花”，也没什么新奇的，其实就是包子。
Oh, you're up early today, Your Excellency. I made breakfast. Would you like some? These are "Tangbao"; we sometimes call them "Plum Blossoms in a Cave," but they're simply soup-filled buns.
信任-朝晨
信任达到20%解锁		EN 中 日 한 箱中日夜变幻不同外界，最近起得越发晚了……一日之计在于晨，该打起精神去做晨课了！
I find myself waking later and later these days; could it be that there is some sort of time difference inside of this place? At any rate, I must not waste the morning. Time for my exercises!
夜暮EN 中 日 한 晚上好，大人。这么晚了还在巡房？不过请放心，今夜是我轮值，尽可安心。
Good evening, Your Excellency. It's late. Are you still out and about? I will be on patrol tonight. So, please rest assured. There will be nothing to worry about.
信任-夜暮
信任达到30%解锁		EN 中 日 한 大人，属下有一问不知当讲不当讲……嗯，只是发现大人经常这个时候巡房。不知是有什么说法？
Your Excellency, there's a question I've been wondering ... I often see you doing rounds through the Suitcase at this time of the day. Have you some reason to come at this time?
帽檐与发鬓EN 中 日 한 此次朝廷派我来此地，本为调查城内异变。只是朝廷身份在这里着实有些显眼，师父便给了我一顶斗笠方便隐藏身份。他说只需戴上便无人能认出我。起初我还将信将疑，只是见他神色着实真切，便也信了……现在想来怕是又被他骗了。
I have been sent from the Imperial Court to investigate a most serious incident. However, I'm aware my outfit could be eye-catching here. That is why my master gave me this hat, so that whatever glances come my way, my identity would remain shrouded. I was doubtful ... and now I fear your expression proves that it was but another lie.
袖与手EN 中 日 한 这把刀是朝廷派发的，本身倒没什么特别的。刀法有云：“刀有形而无心不锐，有心而无锋则利。”我不过粗通皮毛，那些真正的高手甚至只需一根柳枝便可退敌。
This blade? It's ordinary really—standard issue to all officers of the North Zhenfu Division. They say that "one who masters the blade requires not a sharp edge to unleash its power." But even if a true master could beat their enemies with a wooden stick, I'm still glad mine is sharp.
衣着与身形EN 中 日 한 抱歉，强梁最近有些闹脾气，我刚刚尝试安抚了一下。近来它几次想要现世玩耍，都因在下公务不便，脱不开身而作罢。大人，梁月有个不情之请……不知这箱中可有地方方便它出来走动走动？
Apologies, Qiangliang has been naughty these days. I was attempting to soothe it ... Really, what it wants is to come out and play. But I've been so busy with my duties that I haven't had time. Your Excellency, may I ask for a favor? Is there any open space in the Suitcase where I might let Qiangliang stretch its legs?
嗜好
信任达到40%解锁		EN 中 日 한 冬日里家乡寒冷，吃的也多是一些暖身子的食物，像什么胡辣汤、油饼、油馍头、茶叶蛋、牛肉盒……那味道可中嘞！咳，大人我是说，在下喜欢的是一些家乡菜。
The winter is freezing back in my hometown; thankfully our local food is very hearty and warm. Hulatang, Youbing, Youmotou, Tea Eggs, and Niurou Hezi ... just thinking of them makes my mouth water! Ahem, I just mean that I like my hometown cuisine.
赞赏
信任达到50%解锁		EN 中 日 한 这里人妖精怪齐聚一堂，融洽无间，属实让我大开眼界。真想让司内的大人们都瞧瞧这般景象，毕竟若能习得一二管理之法，便也就不必成天焦头烂额。
It is truly eye-opening to see so many people living in harmony. I wish my supervisors could see and learn from the residents here. A few well-applied management techniques could solve a lot of conflict.
亲昵
信任达到60%解锁		EN 中 日 한 大人，这些是我曾收集的一些小物件，并非什么名贵之物。只是每每远行我便带在身边，待到思乡情浓时便会拿出来看上一看。如今我在此可能要待上许久，请问我可以将它们存在这屋中吗？
These? Nothing really, just some gadgets I've collected over the years. I take them with me whenever I leave home. It helps me to stay connected with my roots. As my mission may keep me here a long time, I humbly ask that I might place these in the lobby.
闲谈ⅠEN 中 日 한 我刚刚看到了一位挎着包的姑娘，她似乎在跟自己的挎包交流？不用管她吗？是，在下只是觉得她总有些……行动太过敏捷。
I just saw a girl talking to her handbag? Should I have left her alone? I see. It's just ... she seems oddly agile.
闲谈ⅡEN 中 日 한 在下年幼时，每逢月黑风高夜，便多恶人作祟，以致四邻不安，人人自危。后我家遭贼，幸得师父相助。事后我便跟着师父他入了北镇抚司。只希望能惩恶扬善，有朝一日百姓夜不闭户，安享太平。
When I was only a child, there was so much crime that we didn't feel safe to sleep through the night. After my home was robbed, it was my master who arrived to help us. I decided then and there that I must learn from him and join the North Zhenfu Division. Now I help those in need and right their wrongs so that one day everyone, rich and poor alike, can sleep safely.
独白
信任达到70%解锁		EN 中 日 한 以前镇抚司办案，强调证据，若无明确罪证不得擅自抓人。只是近来朝中越发浑浊，三公六部相互攻讦。南北镇抚司亦不得不选边站队，这抓人的证据便也越发不重要了。我受不得这些，恰逢司内要求彻查此案，我便接了差事来了这儿。
With so much chaos in the Imperial Court, conflict between my superiors and the other divisions became inevitable. In time they stopped caring about evidence and justice; all that mattered was seeking glory or finding someone to blame. I had almost given up hope, but with this mission, I finally have a chance to do my duty—the right way.
入队EN 中 日 한 北镇抚司公办，闲人避让。
North Zhenfu Division business. Make way.
战前EN 中 日 한 前方何人？
Who's there?
择选咒语ⅠEN 中 日 한 不必多言。
Don't waste your breath.
择选咒语ⅡEN 中 日 한 横锋护元。
Keep your guard high.
择选高阶咒语EN 中 日 한 无奈之举，多有得罪。
I must ask your pardon for this.
择选至终的仪式EN 中 日 한 破敌之策，了然于心。
I have the means to destroy them.
释放神秘术ⅠEN 中 日 한 迅若脱兔！
Swift as a hare!
释放神秘术ⅠEN 中 日 한 金石为开！
Cleave through solid stone!
释放神秘术ⅡEN 中 日 한 紧则无密。
A well-measured strike.
释放神秘术ⅡEN 中 日 한 疏则无缺。
A flawless defense.
召唤至终的仪式EN 中 日 한 险道逐疫，万恶皆除。强梁，出！
Banish all evil and cleanse this place!
受敌ⅠEN 中 日 한 咳！
Urgh!
受敌ⅡEN 中 日 한 放肆！
How dare you!
战斗胜利EN 中 日 한 有什么话留到公堂再说吧。
Save your words for the court.
洞悉
洞悉后解锁		EN 中 日 한 纵持“百兵之胆”，亦只能斩断眼前杂事。然天下苍苍，作为梁家后人，自当为人前，为社稷，为苍生，争上一争。
We call it the "General of Weapons," yet it is rare that I find a problem I can end with my sword alone. But whether by a blade or any other tool, as a descendant of the Liang, it is my duty to protect the innocent.
洞悉之底
获得对应衣着解锁		EN 中 日 한 师父刀法高强，当年就用一把官刀在我眼前做了一份蓑衣黄瓜……今日事罢，我也试试，不知有无他老人家当日三分功力。
My master is highly skilled with a blade. I once saw him slice up a cucumber salad in a single motion. I should like to try that myself ... Hmm, but I fear I would only make a mess.
入场EN 中 日 한 官府办事，闲人退避。我不是说大人您是闲人……咳，大人，这边请。
No unauthorized visitors allowed—ah, Your Excellency, I didn't mean ... Ahem, right this way, please.
主页交互触发EN 中 日 한 在下的刀法？要看的话，我怕此地施展不开……也罢，我试一试。
You want me to demonstrate my skills? Given the space here, maybe there's another way to show you.
交互成功前半EN 中 日 한 那么在下献丑了。
Well, if you insist.
交互成功后半1EN 中 日 한 这般如何？只是心中忽有形象，便雕了出来，大人若是喜欢，尽可拿去。
What do you think? It just came to my mind. If you incline to keep it, be my guest.
交互成功后半2EN 中 日 한 这般如何？只是心中忽有形象，便雕了出来，大人若是喜欢，尽可拿去。
What do you think? It just came to my mind. If you incline to keep it, be my guest.
交互成功后半3EN 中 日 한 这般如何？只是心中忽有形象，便雕了出来，大人若是喜欢，尽可拿去。
What do you think? It just came to my mind. If you incline to keep it, be my guest.
未交互1EN 中 日 한 啊，不看了吗？没有，我只是觉得来都来了……
You don't see it? It's just ... we've come so far ...
未交互2EN 中 日 한 啊，不看了吗？没有，我只是觉得来都来了……
You don't see it? It's just ... we've come so far ...
